properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ships SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 hash implementations inside the hardhat/ethers dev toolchain of an example project; not imported by first-party code. Changeable only by bumping the upstream packages that pull it (elliptic chain). Same node_modules package as LIB-e966a74e (hash.js).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Quantum-unsafe ECDSA on the Koblitz secp256k1 curve, pulled into every example install by the hardhat-3/@nomicfoundation toolchain for Ethereum wallet signing at dev time. Migration note: secp256k1 is Ethereum consensus-fixed, so it is observable here but replaceable only by the ecosystem's own PQ roadmap — bump/ban at the toolchain level is the actionable fix.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Legacy weak KDF (single-round MD5) retained in the dependency tree of the example installs via the old browserify crypto stack; no first-party call site feeds it passwords. Changeable by removing the upstream chain that pulls it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves is the modern JS EC library that ethers/hardhat-ethers pulls in; its secp256k1 module provides the ECDSA+ECDH the toolchain uses for wallet keys at dev time. Changeable by bumping ethers/hardhat-ethers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic is the older JS EC library transitively pulled by the toolchain (via the secp256k1/browserify-era chain); no first-party import anywhere in the repo. Changeable only by pruning the upstream chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: p256 module of @noble/curves, pulled via ethers into the example toolchain; NIST P-256 ECDSA/ECDH is Shor-vulnerable. No first-party call site in this repo. Changeable by bumping ethers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic's ECDH path is shipped with the example toolchain; no first-party call site found. Same quantum-unsafe status as its ECDSA path (Shor breaks the ECDLP).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js is pulled by the ethers toolchain for encrypted JSON keystore (Web3 Secret Storage) support; scrypt itself is memory-hard symmetric (Grover-only, not Shor) and its cost parameters live in the caller. Same node_modules package as LIB-73d70f43 (scrypt-js).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes (sha3/keccak/sha256/blake3) is pulled via ethers into the example toolchain; first-party keccak256 use in this repo lives in packages/core/src (covered by ALG-052c24b2) and plugin-hardhat/src (reported as a new finding). Changeable by bumping ethers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Canonical entry for the elliptic package: transitive EC library (ECDSA/ECDH over secp256k1, P-256, Ed25519) shipped in the example toolchain; ALG-710f61f0 (its ECDSA) and ALG-c9ffc8a8 (its ECDH) are this same package viewed as capabilities. No first-party import.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2 npm package (browserify-compatible PBKDF2), used by the ethers toolchain for Web3 Secret Storage keystore derivation (high iteration counts live in the caller). No first-party call site.
